summary: Prevent false-red operation cards during active context compression
description: Operation cards currently derive stall state only from the model-call counter. Agent activity heartbeats such as context compression in progress refresh last_activity_ts but are ignored, causing active work to render red after the stall threshold. Carry the activity heartbeat into progress tracking without masking genuinely stale workers.
acceptance: Fresh activity heartbeat prevents stalled=true even when the model-call counter is unchanged.
A stale heartbeat with an unchanged counter still becomes stalled after the configured threshold.
Rendered operation cards distinguish active compression from genuine no-progress state.
